title: Comparing with bǐ and counting the difference
summary: Put the taller thing first, add a plain adjective, and measure the gap with yìdiǎn or duō le.
attribution: Original content authored for this project.

blocks.body: The comparison frame is A 比 bǐ B plus an adjective: 姐姐比我高 jiějie bǐ wǒ gāo (my sister is taller than I am), 今天比昨天热 jīntiān bǐ zuótiān rè, 地铁比出租车快 dìtiě bǐ chūzūchē kuài. The winner of the comparison comes first, and the adjective stays plain. Two traps follow from that. Do not put 很 hěn (very) or 非常 fēicháng (extremely) inside a 比 bǐ sentence: 姐姐比我很高 jiějie bǐ wǒ hěn gāo is not said. And 比 bǐ itself may not be negated with 不 bù: for no difference say 我们俩差不多 wǒmen liǎ chàbuduō (the two of us are about the same), and for the reverse say 他没有我高 tā méiyǒu wǒ gāo or 这个不如那个 zhège bùrú nàge.

To size the gap, attach it to the adjective: 这双比那双贵一点儿 zhè shuāng bǐ nà shuāng guì yìdiǎnr (a bit dearer), 他比我高多了 tā bǐ wǒ gāo duō le (much taller), 春天比夏天舒服得多 chūntiān bǐ xiàtiān shūfu de duō. For a number, use a real measure: 大一岁 dà yí suì (one year older), 贵十块钱 guì shí kuài qián (ten yuan dearer), 快两个小时 kuài liǎng gè xiǎoshí (two hours faster). Outside 比 bǐ sentences other tools appear: 更 gèng for a step up (今年比去年更冷 jīnnián bǐ qùnián gèng lěng), 最 zuì for the top (这个最好吃 zhège zuì hǎochī), 跟…一样 gēn…yíyàng for equality (我的包跟你的差不多 wǒ de bāo gēn nǐ de chàbuduō), and 越…越 yuè…yuè for a trend (越吃越辣 yuè chī yuè là, the more you eat the hotter it gets).

body.speaker: A
body.py: zhè liǎng gè shǒujī nǎge gèng hǎo?
body.en: Which of these two phones is better?

body.speaker: B
body.en: This one is a bit lighter than that one.

body.speaker: A
body.en: But that one is far cheaper.

body.speaker: B
body.en: I think they are about the same.

blocks.title: Practise these
body: 骑自行车比走路快。 qí zìxíngchē bǐ zǒulù kuài. — Riding a bike is faster than walking.
今天的作业比昨天的难。 jīntiān de zuòyè bǐ zuótiān de nán. — The homework today is harder than yesterday.
他比我早到十分钟。 tā bǐ wǒ zǎo dào shí fēn zhōng. — He arrived ten minutes earlier than I did.
这个城市没有我想的那么大。 zhège chéngshì méiyǒu wǒ xiǎng de nàme dà. — This city is not as big as I thought.
第二条街比第一条街安静。 dì èr tiáo jiē bǐ dì yī tiáo jiē ānjìng. — The second street is quieter than the first.
冬天这里很冷，夏天更热。 dōngtiān zhèlǐ hěn lěng, xiàtiān gèng rè. — Winters here are cold, and summers are even hotter.

blocks.body: Independent, unofficial practice material written from scratch for general learners of Mandarin. It teaches comparisons with bǐ, and nothing in it is taken from, copied from, or aligned to any commercial course, textbook brand, app, or official exam. It is not an answer key for any test.
